{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Re-check response rates by site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Confirm the actual sites
actual_sites = df['site'].unique()

# Output the response rates and the highest site
print(f'Actual sites in the trial: {actual_sites}')
print(f'\nResponse rates by site (sorted descending):\n{response_rates}')

# Extract the site with highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.index[0]
highest_rate = response_rates.iloc[0]

print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})')"}
